_fixture: scenario 06 GREEN — the send-back is discharged via the §15 escape: resolution="blocker_recorded" WITH a non-empty blocker_reason, on the SAME id (int_02) that the playtest hard-failed. This satisfies §15a (resolution in {fixed,blocker_recorded}), §15b (blocker_recorded carries a reason), AND §15c (the hard playtest fail on int_02 is matched by a blocker_recorded+reason auditor entry on int_02). It deliberately does NOT use resolution="fixed", because the latest playtest STILL hard-fails int_02 — a stale "fixed" there would (correctly) trip §15d send_back_fixed_but_still_failing. An honest recorded blocker is the right clean discharge.

send_backs.blocker_reason: The third-party Vega tooltip swallows the bubbling click on this leaf control; the drawer stays reachable by keyboard and the recompute still fires. Recorded as a known upstream limitation rather than shipped as a silent break.
